# Gruha

> Gruha is a "See it in your room" button for furniture and décor brands' product pages. A shopper uploads a photo of their own room, and the product appears in it at its real size, lit by the room's own light, with an itemised price in ₹ and a link straight to the brand's checkout. It runs on the product photos already on the brand's site, so no 3D models are needed. It is a Shopify app, and one script tag for WooCommerce or any other website.

Gruha is made in India (Hyderabad). It is an AI render of a photo of the shopper's own room, not augmented reality.

## Who it is for

- Furniture and home-décor brands selling online, and their e-commerce teams
- Sales and WhatsApp teams, who can send back a finished render and a priced quote instead of a catalogue link

## How it works

1. One button on the product page, switched on from the theme editor. Nothing in the theme is edited.
2. The customer uploads a photo of the room they are buying for, bare or already lived-in, from the phone camera or gallery.
3. The product appears in it at its real size, lit by the light already in that room. It takes about a minute.
4. An itemised quote in ₹, with a buy link to the product page.

Several products can be placed in one room, with colour and fabric variants. Shoppers can share the render on WhatsApp or download it. Brands get a live usage dashboard, the most-visualised products and a CSV export. Consent is taken before any photo is sent, and photos are deleted after 90 days.

## Pricing

- Starter: ₹4,999 per month, 5,000 credits (about 125 renders)
- Growth: ₹9,999 per month, 10,000 credits (about 250 renders)
- White-label: ₹17,999 per month, 10,000 credits (250 renders), no Gruha badge
- One credit is ₹1; one render is 40 credits; a failed render is free. Top-ups are the same rate and never expire. Cancel any time. Prices exclude GST.

## Honest limits

- It is a visualisation, not a photograph.
- A daylit indoor photo gives a much better result than a dim or outdoor one.
- When a room has nowhere sensible for a large piece, it says so and asks for a better photo rather than inventing a spot.
- Results vary with the room; products are tested before anything goes live.
